newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end mostly up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end mostly up in thin trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures drifted back up late to end mostly higher in thin dealings, traders said.
Lumber ended $2.00 per tbf lower to $6.60 higher with only limitless May off at $390.50 and July up $2.20 at $393.20.

Futures eased early on carryover weakness from Friday following the weak undertone to cash lumber, but prices drifted back as selling subsided. Most months moved up for gains following the strong tone to the stock market and expectations of lower interest rates, traders said.
Futures may drift until cash trade moves the market, they added.
